Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Operation.LdapSearchOperation
Class.Description: This class is used to search LDAP API. This Operation accepts three different types of requests. Ens.StringRequest and Ens.StreamContainer - When this two request are used it uses DN, LdapSearchScome and LdapAttributes from the Operation settings to perform the search call .IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DStruc.LdapSearchRequest - When it receives this request type it retrieves DN, LdapSearchScome and LdapAttributes from the request to perform the search.

Property.name: LdapAttributes
Property.Description: comma-separated list of attributes to return per found entry.
